mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days when the rate falls below 5.0%.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution in periods of FEDFUNDS < 5.0% shows no significant positive bias compared to the overall market (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE < 4.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform the market in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates deepening economic contraction, triggering a flight to quality that produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where both GDPC1 and HOUST decline are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal does not have a Rank IC > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO rises are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform the market in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods of high RSAFS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal does not have a Rank IC > 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index rises above 305.0, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL > 305.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform the market in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates robust labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the joint signal does not have a Rank IC > 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, a rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive interest rate hikes that reduce corporate borrowing and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal fails to outperform the market in > 60% of such periods.
